llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial comparing surgical approaches and does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or implant mechanics, nor does it provide any finite element data.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较直接前入路与后外侧入路全髋关节置换术的早期功能恢复。
summary_zh.method: 随机对照试验，纳入患者进行两种手术入路。
summary_zh.result: 直接前入路在早期功能恢复上可能有优势。

summary_en.motivation: To compare early functional recovery between direct anterior and posterolateral approaches in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial with patients assigned to either surgical approach.
summary_en.result: The direct anterior approach showed potential advantages in early functional recovery.

papers.title: Cell Sheets of Co-cultured Endothelial Progenitor Cells and Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Promote Osseointegration in Irradiated Rat Bone.
papers.abstract: Irradiated bone has a greater risk of implant failure than nonirradiated bone. The purpose of this study was to investigate the influence of cell sheets composed of co-cultured bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells (BMSCs) and endothelial progenitor cells (EPCs) on implant osseointegration in irradiated bone. Cell sheets (EPCs, BMSCs or co-cultured EPCs and BMSCs) were wrapped around titanium implants to make cell sheet-implant complexes. The co-cultured group showed the highest osteogenic differentiation potential in vitro, as indicated by the extracellular matrix mineralization and the expression of osteogenesis related genes at both mRNA and protein levels. The co-cultured cells promoted ectopic bone formation as indicated by micro-computed tomography (Micro-CT) and histological analysis. In the irradiated tibias of rats, implants of the co-cultured group showed enhanced osseointegration by Micro-CT evaluation and histological observation. Co-cultured EPCs and BMSCs also up-regulated the expression of osteogenesis related genes in bone fragments in close contact with implants. In conclusion, cell sheets of co-cultured EPCs and BMSCs could promote osseous healing around implants and are potentially useful to improve osseointegration process for patients after radiotherapy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究细胞片对辐照骨中植入物骨整合的促进作用，未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善放疗后患者骨整合不良的问题
summary_zh.method: 将共培养的内皮祖细胞和间充质基质细胞片包裹于钛植入物表面
summary_zh.result: 共培养细胞片显著促进辐照大鼠胫骨的骨整合与成骨基因表达
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠辐照胫骨模型体内验证，结合Micro-CT和组织学分析

summary_en.motivation: To address the increased risk of implant failure in irradiated bone by enhancing osseointegration through cellular therapy.
summary_en.method: Cell sheets composed of co-cultured endothelial progenitor cells and mesenchymal stromal cells were wrapped around titanium implants for in vivo implantation.
summary_en.result: Co-cultured cell sheets significantly improved osseointegration and upregulated osteogenic gene expression in irradiated rat tibiae.
summary_en.validation: In vivo validation using a rat model of irradiated tibia with Micro-CT and histological evaluation.

papers.title: Nuclear Discrepancy for Active Learning
papers.abstract: Active learning algorithms propose which unlabeled objects should be queried for their labels to improve a predictive model the most. We study active learners that minimize generalization bounds and uncover relationships between these bounds that lead to an improved approach to active learning. In particular we show the relation between the bound of the state-of-the-art Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) active learner, the bound of the Discrepancy, and a new and looser bound that we refer to as the Nuclear Discrepancy bound. We motivate this bound by a probabilistic argument: we show it considers situations which are more likely to occur. Our experiments indicate that active learning using the tightest Discrepancy bound performs the worst in terms of the squared loss. Overall, our proposed loosest Nuclear Discrepancy generalization bound performs the best. We confirm our probabilistic argument empirically: the other bounds focus on more pessimistic scenarios that are rarer in practice. We conclude that tightness of bounds is not always of main importance and that active learning methods should concentrate on realistic scenarios in order to improve performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究主动学习的泛化界，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on active learning theory for classification/regression, not on surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索主动学习中不同泛化界的关系，提出更优的查询策略。
summary_zh.method: 推导核差异（Nuclear Discrepancy）界，并与MMD和Discrepancy界比较。
summary_zh.result: 最松的核差异界在实际中表现最好，紧界反而效果差。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准分类数据集上比较不同界的主动学习性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the relationship between different generalization bounds in active learning and propose a bound that better reflects realistic scenarios.
summary_en.method: Derives the Nuclear Discrepancy bound and compares it with Maximum Mean Discrepancy and Discrepancy bounds theoretically and empirically.
summary_en.result: The loosest Nuclear Discrepancy bound achieves the best active learning performance, while tighter bounds perform worse due to over-pessimism.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on standard classification datasets comparing active learning methods based on different bounds.
